Overview & Location
Down to earth, relaxed, innovative and charming are Etosha Safari Camp's alluring qualities - and of course, its proximity to Etosha National Park . This family friendly safari camp hosts 50 cosy chalets offering comfortable accommodation between the mopane trees, an inviting circular swimming pool, and ample character.
Extending the theme of Etosha as being a 'Place of Legends', Etosha Safari Camp takes it one step further by bringing home the story and spirit of Africa. And the result is - legendary! Here, the typical informal bar or shebeen, well-known and beloved throughout southern Africa, is given expression in the Okambashu ('Our home') restaurant and Oshebeena bar with local colour and country bric-a-brac. Outside in the courtyard the Etosha Boys strum guitars and sing lively local songs.
During the day, African wildlife takes priority. The Andersson Gate, the portal to the magnificence of the animal kingdom, is only 10km away. Explore the Etosha National Park on your own or join our professional guides for an enlightening and informative wildlife journey. From the black-faced impala to the wizened elephant giants and lion kings, Namibia’s wild world is simply spellbinding.
As the end of the day approaches, race the sun home to Etosha Safari Camp to laughter, comfort and good cheer. Tap toes to the beat of Africa.

Frequently Asked Questions
Whether you are planning a luxury safari across our distinctive lodge or collections or booking a self-drive adventure, find quick, expert answers to your Namibia travel logistics here. From navigating gravel roads to understanding park inclusions and wildlife seasons, we have curated everything you need to prepare for an unforgettable Namibian journey.
Namibia Travel FAQs
Accommodation & Experiences
Sustainability & Conservation
Families & Accessibility
Which Gondwana lodges are best for Etosha National Park?
Gondwana Collection Namibia offers several excellent safari lodges near Etosha National Park , ideal for wildlife viewing and guided game drives.
Etosha Safari Lodge : Located only 10 km from Etosha’s Anderson Gate, this popular safari lodge offers panoramic savannah views, guided game drives, swimming pools, and easy access to the national park.
Etosha Safari Camp & Campsite : A relaxed and family-friendly option near Etosha with campsites, chalets, access to the main lodge restaurant and swimming pool, and convenient park access.
Etosha King Nehale : A more exclusive luxury safari lodge near Etosha’s northern gate, inspired by Ovambo culture and offering private access to the Ontalelo Outpost waterhole inside the national park.
The Ekipa : Gondwana Collection’s luxury safari villa near Etosha National Park, designed for travellers seeking privacy, exclusivity, and personalised service. The Ekipa offers a premium safari experience with elegant suites, private dining, a dedicated host, and access to exceptional wildlife experiences in northern Namibia.
These lodges provide excellent access to Etosha National Park and are among the best accommodation options for Namibia wildlife safaris and self-drive safari holidays.
Can Gondwana assist with travel planning?
Yes, Gondwana Collection Namibia offers personalised travel planning and tailor-made Namibia safari itineraries through the Gondwana Travel Centre . The team can assist with:
Custom Namibia travel itineraries
Luxury safari planning
Self-drive holiday routes
Lodge and hotel bookings
Car rental and 4x4 hire
Charter flights and transfers
Family holidays and honeymoon planning
Namibia2Go also provides direct booking support for Gondwana Collection lodges and other accommodation across Namibia.
For travellers who prefer guided transport, the Go2 Tourism Shuttle connects major destinations including Sossusvlei , Swakopmund , Etosha National Park , and Victoria Falls .
When is the best time to visit Namibia?
Namibia is a year-round travel destination, but the best time to visit depends on the type of safari or holiday experience travellers are looking for.
May to October (dry season): Best for wildlife viewing and Etosha safaris , as animals gather around waterholes.
November to April (green season): Ideal for birdwatching, photography, dramatic landscapes, and fewer crowds.
The Namib Desert , Sossusvlei, Swakopmund , and many luxury lodges such as Namib Desert Lodge , Desert Whisper and The Delight Swakopmund hotel can be enjoyed throughout the year thanks to Namibia’s sunny climate and wide-open landscapes.
Is Namibia safe for travellers?
Yes, Namibia is one of the safest travel destinations in Africa for self-drive holidays, luxury safaris, and guided tours. The country is politically stable, tourist-friendly, and known for its scenic road trips and world-class wildlife experiences.
Namibia is especially popular for self-drive travel, with good road networks connecting top destinations such as Etosha National Park , Swakopmund , the Namib desert, Damaraland and the Skeleton Coast. Most visitors enjoy safe and trouble-free travel throughout the country.
Namibia is a safe and rewarding destination for solo travellers, couples, families, and first-time visitors to Africa.
As with any destination, travellers should follow standard travel precautions.
Do I need a 4x4 vehicle to visit Gondwana lodges?
A standard two-wheel drive vehicle is suitable for many Namibia self-drive routes, especially on main roads between Windhoek , Swakopmund , and Etosha National Park . However, a 4x4 vehicle is recommended for more remote areas such as Sossusvlei, Damaraland , Kaokoland , and certain gravel-road routes.
A vehicle with higher ground clearance offers additional comfort, safety, and flexibility for long-distance Namibia road trips.
Gondwana Collection offers vehicle rental through Namibia2Go , including fully equipped 4x4 vehicles designed for Namibia safari travel. Go2 Traveller Transfers are also available for guests who prefer not to drive themselves.
Where can I find reliable lodges in Namibia?
For reliable lodges in Namibia, many travellers choose established lodge groups with strong guest reviews, good safety standards, consistent service, and nationwide travel support.
Gondwana Collection Namibia is one of the most recognised hospitality groups in the country. The company operates more than 50 lodges, camps and safari properties across Namibia. The company is known for its wide range of accommodation options, from luxury desert lodges and Etosha safari camps to glamping and self-catering stays.
Some highly regarded Gondwana lodges include:
Namib Desert Lodge : a popular base for visiting Sossusvlei and the Namib Desert.
Etosha Safari Camp : located close to Etosha National Park and well known for safari experiences.
Namushasha River Lodge : situated in the Zambezi Region near Bwabwata National Park, combining river experiences, wildlife, and cultural excursions.
Canyon Lodge : a unique lodge near Fish River Canyon built among granite boulders, offering scenic hikes, canyon excursions, and tranquil desert landscapes.
Kalahari Anib Lodge : a scenic lodge in the Kalahari ideal for road trips and family travel.
